meaning:
ἡσυχία, -ας, ἡ
(ἡσύχιος, which see), [in LXX for אִישׁוֹן, שָׁלֵו, etc. ;]
1. quietness: 2Th.3:12.
2. stillness, silence: Act.22:2, 1Ti.2:11-12 †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,
Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.
Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.
